text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can paint striking pictures, compose original music, and write poems in seconds. Some artists use these tools to explore new styles, while others worry that machines might replace human imagination. The real difference lies in intention: a human artist draws from personal experience, emotion, and cultural meaning, whereas an AI copies patterns from vast datasets without true understanding. Yet, AI can act as a powerful partner, sparking fresh ideas and removing creative blocks. In the end, creativity may not be a contest between humans and machines, but a collaboration where each side brings unique strengths.
